name: Short Order Cook, Greater
body:
Come and get it!

Prerequisite(s): Int or Wis 19, Improved Short Order Cook, Short Order Cook, 16th-level culinarian, able to add up to 4 ingredients to a meal as a full-round action.

Benefit(s): When creating 3 meals using Improved Short Order Cook, you can add 1 ingredient to each of those meals and begin another meal with a complexity at least 1 lower than the rest.

You must be able to complete all meals on the same turn or you risk losing each.
